integrity: Proof derives singular values from unitary Fourier separation of cyclic matrix diagonals and exact modular residue collisions. Supporting finite numerical checks corroborate but do not certify the universal argument. Earliest motivating preprint first submitted 2026-08-03; earlier cited work is background. Independent publication-priority assessment outstanding.
scientific_limitations: Only deterministic integer quadratic phase masks, all modulations per mask, and complex-linear/Hermitian linear operator reconstruction are covered. Rank-one phase retrieval and stability under arbitrary masks are not asserted. The fourth-overlap potential optimization for odd cycles is earlier published work, not part of the originality claim.
title: Exact operator-lifting spectrum and maximal information for cyclic quadratic-chirp masks
